principle: A station's site follows function. The generator does not place stations at arbitrary aesthetically pleasing coordinates.
rules: Choose site after function and scale are resolved.
A location must outperform plausible alternatives or satisfy a unique constraint.
Hazardous sites may still win for science/strategy but must impose real maintenance/safety cost.
A planet with adequate surface infrastructure does not automatically need an orbital station.
A station at a route junction must serve enough sustained traffic or strategic function to justify fixed presence.
Player convenience is never a placement factor.
